title: Amazon–NetSuite Sync for Beauty Brands: Match Variation Families to ERP Products
summary: Amazon Seller Central order lines land in NetSuite at the child offer, so a variation family never merges several shades or sizes into one ERP item.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Import beauty marketplace evidence at the sellable offer and order-line level, retaining variation-family context without using it as the ERP product key. A parent catalog grouping can contain many shades and sizes. The NetSuite relationship must identify the exact purchased item and preserve seller and marketplace scope.


Explore the complete[personal care integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/personal-care) for the systems and processes around this guide.
